compilerOptions.//noUncheckedIndexedAccess: Types arr[i] as T | undefined. The single most useful flag beyond `strict` — it catches the off-by-one and empty-collection reads that otherwise surface as a runtime crash on a user's device.
compilerOptions.//exactOptionalPropertyTypes: Distinguishes a missing property from one explicitly set to undefined. Matters wherever an object is serialised to an API.
compilerOptions.//noUnusedLocals: Left to ESLint, which understands the `_` prefix convention. Enabling both means two different errors for one problem.
